THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
176
STUDY 068
Y2K Crop Top & Studded Cargo
Rights check
Source: 24403.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark brown hair
stands with one hand in her pocket against a gray
studio backdrop. She wears a dark brown fitted crop
top, layered silver chains, and a wide studded belt with
a pendant. Dark cargo trousers with drawstring pockets
and silver bangles complete the look. Her expression is
confident, with a slight smirk. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of chocolate, charcoal gray, and silver. Playful
and edgy, in the style of a Y2K streetwear lookbook.
Playful, edgy, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The studded belt and cargo trousers are the defining
pieces.
- Add 'full-length' to show the cargo pocket details.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the cargo
pockets.
